messages:
emma: quick postmortem — automatic fallback flipped /summaries/api into degraded-read-only for ~35s during a small 502 burst. operators got a lot of noise and the console showed an opaque `combined_signal` reason :confused:

ryan: can you paste the audit-row? we need to know what the decision service emitted.

emma: we currently have `reason=combined_signal` and a link to an exp-id. no breakdown.

lucas: that's the problem — console can't show contributors without a compact, flat decision blob. Proposal: decision service returns a semicolon-delimited string with only flat fields, e.g. `policy=auto_fallback_v1;decision=soft_degrade;score=0.74;top=5xx:0.6,kv_miss:0.09;hint=hysteresis=18s;audit_id=aud_4977`

priya: love the flat blob. add a short `explain` field with a one-line human reason like "why=5xx spike + cache misses" for quick reading. Also add a tiny `confidence_band` (low/med/high) so ops know how borderline the decision is.

ryan: UX asks: console should show a compact banner on the route page with the blob fields parsed into badge + tooltip. tooltip shows top3 signals and a 30s sparkline. also a small "Inspect audit" button that opens the sampled payload modal.

emma: sampling note: do NOT dump full payloads into the main audit index. store sampled payloads in S3 under the audit_id. default sample policy: always sample up to N requests per degraded-event (e.g., 10 reqs) + 0.2% for normal degradations. on-call can mint a short token to fetch more samples for 15m.

lucas: retention/cost mitigation: sampled payloads TTL=7d, compact index entries keep only ids + compact blob. writeable audit annotations should be short strings only (e.g., `annot=snooze;by=ryan;dur=30m`).

priya: inbox behavior: group all events for a route into a single thread for the same degradation incident. thread shows counts, first/last timestamps, and the decision blob. one-click actions: Snooze (5/30/60m), Mark benign, Escalate (creates incident). Snooze writes an audit annotation as above.

emma: safety: add an oscillation detector that bumps hysteresis by x2 if flips >3 within 10m. and a spike_guard: ignore single-window spikes if score only crosses threshold by <10% and duration <20s.

ryan: API change: decision service expose `/v1/policy/evaluate?route=/summaries/api&window=30s` returning the flat semicolon blob only. SDKs can include a tiny parse helper. Keep fields string-only (no nested JSON).

lucas: also include `sanity_check` field when a decision escalates to hard-degrade, e.g. `sanity_check=passed` or `sanity_check=flagged` so the console can show a red notice when rules look suspicious.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: policy/decision-blob-flat-format + spike_guard -> canary 3% at 14:00 UTC :rocket:

priya: next steps: lucas will add the audit blob spec + example strings; ryan will mock the compact banner and inbox grouping; emma will write a 3-line runbook for on-call; i'll draft sampling rates and TTLs. aim to merge PRs before canary.

emma: thanks team — this should cut noise and make the console actionable :thumbsup:
